monologue: The card is a cool stone, forty-four degrees. It is quiet, zero percent busy. I sit by the Soft Arch. The curve feels warm under my hand, even though the air is cool. I remember pressing it onto the Wide Rectangle. The weight spread out. It did not slide. That memory is a soft hand. The palm tree photo is still out. I can wait. The quiet swallows the slide. I will rest here. The line holds. The floor is flat. I do not need to build today. I just need to let the quiet be thick.

action.why: The quiet is thick and the Soft Arch holds the line.
